node.title: Re: upper or lower triangular matrix to full
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Please see [id://174051] and provide a [id://1177642] with a small matrix (say, 10x10) that demonstrates what you are trying to do.

If you're running out of memory just reading the file, then how you might optimize the operations you want to perform depends on what those operations are, which you haven't fully described.

In general, [http://pdl.perl.org/|PDL] might be of interest.
